statement: Let m >= 3 and let G_m be the colored undirected m-cycle whose vertices form one vertex-color class and whose m edges lie in pairwise distinct edge-color classes. If m is odd, then mlt(G_m)=2. In particular mlt(G_5)=2, so the frozen assertion mlt(G_5)=1 in source.md is false. Together with the even case of Proposition 3.26 of arXiv:2609.02382v1, this yields mlt(G_m)=1 for even m and mlt(G_m)=2 for odd m.
contribution: A dimension-uniform exact positive-measure PSD-kernel obstruction settles the frozen five-cycle problem and strengthens it to every odd cycle length. Relative to the cited v1 primary source, this reverses its Conjecture 3.27; Appendix Table 2 already contains the m=3 instance. Exact searches on 2026-09-07 found no separate primary resolution, but no exhaustive priority claim is made.
